data.one_liner: Convert widgets, local, network images or SVGs to BitmapDescriptor for google_maps_flutter markers
data.what_it_does: Provides helper functions to turn a widget, asset image, network image or SVG into a BitmapDescriptor that can be used as a marker icon. Supports custom shapes, borders and text overlays.
use_when: You need custom marker icons that are not simple icons
You want to use a widget or SVG as a marker
You need to load images from the network and resize them for markers
avoid_when: You only need default marker icons
strengths: Supports widgets, assets, network images, SVGs, and custom text overlays
weaknesses: Requires async calls for image loading
No support for other map plugins
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and import package; no special permissions needed
data.minimal_example:
```dart
final marker = await MarkerIcon.downloadResizePictureCircle(
  'https://example.com/image.png',
  size: 150,
  addBorder: true,
  borderColor: Colors.white,
  borderSize: 15,
);
Marker(
  markerId: MarkerId('id'),
  icon: marker,
  position: LatLng(35.0, 50.0),
);
```
